docs.title: Elements
docs.text:
Every monster has a race base of 1% to 10% on fire, earth, water and air (never neutral), plus its element profile: +10% on its own element and -20% on the element that beats it (fire beats earth, earth beats air, air beats water, water beats fire). Many monsters roll their element each spawn; those are marked random element and show only the race base, the same for every roll. A plus means it takes that much less from that element (it resists it), a minus that much more (it is weak to it); a blank cell is 0%. There is no attack x defence chart.
